subject: SCIM provisioning evidence & architecture diagrams request
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Alex Jensen <alex.jensen@nimbussec.com>, Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@vendr.co>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-13T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SCIM provisioning evidence & architecture diagrams request

Hi Alex / Marta —

Following up on Nimbus' Vendr onboarding: our security team needs a couple of SCIM-related artifacts to complete the vendor profile and map CAIQ identity controls. Specifically we need: 

- Confirmation whether Vendr supports inbound SCIM v2 provisioning (bulk and incremental delta).
- A one-page architecture diagram that shows where SCIM sits relative to your IdP / SSO (SAML / OIDC), the provisioning service, and any intermediate syncing layer. Diagram should label the SCIM endpoints and any callback/webhook URLs if present.
- Sample provisioning logs or a delta CSV (last 30 days) showing create/update/deactivate events (redact PII as needed) so our risk team can validate lifecycle behavior.
- The SCIM schema attributes you expose (username, email, externalId, groups, manager, custom:role, etc.) and the group->role mapping you recommend for at least three example roles (admin, developer, read-only).
- Any temporary/test SCIM token or a sandbox tenant we can use to run an automated smoke test.

We will attach a mapping template (redwood_scim_attribute_map.csv) and a rough CAIQ excerpt that indicates which control questions rely on provisioning (identity lifecycle, account provisioning/deprovisioning). If possible, can you provide the architecture diagram as PNG/SVG and the provisioning logs as CSV?

Timeline: our security reviewer has a compliance cut on 2026-09-20. If we can get the artifacts and, ideally, an hour window for a short walkthrough before 2026-09-17, that would keep us on track for the onboarding milestone.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Laura Bennett
Senior Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0187

Attachments: redwood_scim_attribute_map.csv (template)
From: Alex Jensen <alex.jensen@nimbussec.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@vendr.co>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-13T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SCIM provisioning evidence & architecture diagrams request

Hi Laura —

Thanks for the clear list. Quick answers and next steps from our side: 

1) Vendr (our identity/provisioning team) does support SCIM 2.0 inbound provisioning and incremental delta via the /Users and /Groups endpoints. We also support a bulk CSV ingest for migrations.

2) I attached our vendor-facing SCIM guide (vendor_scim_guide.md) that includes endpoints, example payloads, and token lifecycle. For security reasons the production token is never sent via email; we can provision a sandbox token and rotate it after your tests.

3) We can export a 30-day delta CSV showing create/update/deactivate events — we'll redact emails to hashed values for shared logs. Confirm if a hashed-email or pseudonymized id is acceptable for your audit.

4) For the group->role mapping we have a recommended mapping table; I'll request a short export from our provisioning team and share by EOD tomorrow. 

5) Regarding the architecture diagram: we can produce a simple PNG that shows SSO -> IdP -> SCIM sync agent -> Vendr account store, with notes on where logs are captured. Expect that by tomorrow as well.

Questions for you: 
- Is Redwood able to provide a test user creation endpoint we can call to validate provisioning? Or would your team prefer to run the smoke tests against a Nimbus sandbox tenant?
- Your security team mentioned CAIQ mappings — do you want a matrix that maps specific CAIQ question IDs to SCIM artifacts (e.g., identity lifecycle Q2.1 -> provisioning logs)? We can do that but need the list of CAIQ items to tie to.

We'll attach vendor_scim_guide.md in our response and follow up with the CSV/log export via a secure link (S3 presigned) to keep data out of email.

Best,
Alex Jensen
Director, Security Operations
Nimbus Security
alex.jensen@nimbussec.com

On Sun, Sep 13, 2026 at 09:12 AM Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com> wrote:
> Following up on Nimbus' Vendr onboarding: our security team needs a couple of SCIM-related artifacts to complete the vendor profile and map CAIQ identity controls...
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Alex Jensen <alex.jensen@nimbussec.com>, Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@vendr.co>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T08:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SCIM provisioning evidence & architecture diagrams request

Alex — great, thanks for the fast turn. A few clarifications and next steps: 

- Hashed-email is fine for the delta export (please include a consistent hash so we can track events tied to the same account across rows).
- We'll provision a short-lived test account in our staging environment and send you the service account details via the secure upload form you prefer (please provide the presigned S3 link or a secure file drop).
- For CAIQ mapping: I've attached a short list of CAIQ control IDs our reviewer flagged (identity lifecycle, account termination, privileged account ownership). If you can map those to the artifacts (provisioning logs, webhook receipts, token rotation policy) that will expedite sign-off.

I've attached a network/architecture diagram (network_diagram_v1.png) that shows where Redwood will call the SCIM endpoints for provisioning and where we will capture the webhook receipts. Also attached is our filled attribute map (redwood_scim_attribute_map.csv) with the attributes we plan to send.

Proposed sync/checkpoint: let's do a 30-minute working call tomorrow 2026-09-15 at 10:00 AM PT to walk the team through the diagram and run a simple create->update->deactivate test. Karthik and Ben from our side will join. If that works, Marta can send a calendar invite with the sandbox token details.

Thanks — Laura

Laura Bennett
Senior Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0187

Attachments: network_diagram_v1.png, redwood_scim_attribute_map.csv, scim_provisioning_spec.pdf
